reason: A DSH Web GUI skin focused on visual styling, typography, theme colors, scrollbars, badges, and light/dark appearance options.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 Claude 风格的暖黑配色、字体切换、细滚动条、焦点样式及亮暗主题界面皮肤。
summaries.en: A Claude-inspired visual skin for the DSH Web GUI with warm-black colors, font switching, refined controls, and light or dark theme support.

capabilities: Customizes the DSH web interface appearance
Provides font style selection for UI, conversation text, and code
Supports light and dark themes that follow system settings
Stores the selected font style in browser localStorage
